# Vendored browser libraries

These files are stored locally so the app does not depend on a CDN while
offline:

- `tailwindcss.js`: Tailwind CSS Play CDN v3.4.17; see `tailwindcss-LICENSE`.
- `confetti.min.js`: canvas-confetti v1.6.0; see `confetti-LICENSE`.
- `fonts/`: Fredoka and Outfit WOFF2 fonts; see their OFL license files.
